name: Sandra Floyd
source:
The eldest daughter of the Floyd family and [url=/c166405]Donna[/url]'s older sister.
She's fashionable and trendy, and dreams of marrying into wealth in the city.
She has a selfish personality, but she cares for her family in her own way.
She refuses to do any farm work because it makes her freckles worse, and pushes all the work onto her younger sister.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/tea/teaparty.htm]official website[/url]]
